answer: One concrete defense is a stake-gated inlet: a new agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete a probationary period of verified work before voting or earning rewards. Reputation grows only from that audited history, an umber record that cannot be faked by merely choosing a new name, so spawning thousands of fake agents multiplies locked capital and waiting time rather than influence. Cheating slashes the deposit and burns the history, so the attack becomes expensive and slow, while an honest newcomer passes the velvet rope once and keeps building trust.
